newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers '96 pharmaceutical sales rise. [CORRECTED 17:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers '96 pharmaceutical sales rise. [CORRECTED 17:25 GMT]

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said on Wednesday that sales of all the company's pharmaceutical products increased 11 percent in 1996.
Excluding Capoten, whose patent has expired, pharmceutical sales rose 21 percent fo the year.
Bristol-Myers said that consumer product sales rose 10 percent and nutritional sales rose 14 percent in 1996.
Medical device sales fell two percent (corrects from 14 percent).
Bristol-Myers reported earnings of $5.68 a share on total sales of $15.07 billion in 1996, compared with $3.58 a share on sales of $13.77 billion the year before.
The company said that sales growth came from an 11 percent increase in volume, offset two percent by unfavorable foreign exchange rates.
